verses.text: For this reason I, Paul, am a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles.
Surely you have heard that God gave me his grace to share with you.
God showed me his secret plan, as I have already written in a few words.
When you read this, you will understand what I know about the secret plan of Christ.
It was not made known to people in earlier times. But now the Spirit has shown it to God's holy apostles and prophets.
This is the secret. Through the Good News, the Gentiles share the inheritance with Israel. They are members of the same body. They share in the promise in Christ Jesus.
I became a servant of this Good News by the gift of God's grace, given to me through his mighty power.
I am less than the least of all God's people. Yet God gave me this grace, to preach to the Gentiles the endless riches of Christ.
He gave me the task of helping everyone see how God's secret plan works. It was hidden for ages in God, who created all things.
God wanted the church to show his wisdom in all its many forms to the rulers and powers in the heavenly places.
This was his eternal purpose, which he carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord.
In Christ, and through faith in him, we can come to God boldly and with confidence.
So I ask you not to lose heart because I am suffering for you. My suffering is for your glory.
For this reason I kneel before the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
from whom every family in heaven and on earth gets its name.
I pray that from his glorious riches he will make you strong in your inner being, with power through his Spirit.
I pray that Christ will live in your hearts through faith. I pray that you will be rooted and built up in love.
Then together with all God's holy people you will have power to understand how wide and long and high and deep it is,
the love of Christ. It is greater than anyone can know. And you will be filled with all the fullness of God.
God can do far more than all we ask or imagine, by his power that is at work in us.
To him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus, through all generations, for ever and ever. Amen.
